limitations: electron drift velocity only: the velocity along E of one 1D Garfield++ gas table (Dimension : F); a table with B or angle grids (Dimension : T) is refused
B = 0 and E along +x (query_fields in V/cm): the velocity components perpendicular to E are exactly zero by construction
temperature and pressure must equal the table's (TGAS, PGAS); any other value is refused with condition-mismatch (no density scaling)
the interpolation order (1 or 2) and the low and high extrapolation methods must equal the table footer's velocity entries (Interp, L Extr, H Extr); the query script sets them explicitly

points outside the table's E range are refused with out-of-domain unless allow_outside_validated_range is true; then Garfield++'s native extrapolation is used and the rows carry outside-validated-range (an adapter policy that differs from native behaviour)
Garfield++ commit e2e58ea74ec8b20d347d78b7a769f40e3b156072 is pinned (docs/dev/detector-simulation/card-GF-QUERY.md); the environment record must name it
verification only: checks 1-4 compare Garfield++ with an independent parser and reimplementation of its interpolation; no agreement with independent gas data and no physical validity is claimed
deterministic: no random number generator, so no seed
